explanation: John the Baptist's role as the forerunner who prepares the way for Jesus by calling people to repentance.
A ritual act in which a person is immersed in water as a sign of cleansing and new beginning.
A symbol of Jesus as the sacrificial offering that takes away the sin of the world, drawn from Old Testament sacrifices.
The divine rule or reign where God's will is fully realized in people's lives and the world.
Deviation from God's laws and righteousness that creates a separation between humans and God.
A deep inner change of heart and mind in which one turns away from sin and back to God.
The title given to Jesus as the beloved Son of God, confirmed at his baptism in the Jordan River.
The act of showing reverence and devotion toward God or a divine being.
A supernatural event performed by Jesus that demonstrates God's power and authority, such as healings and nature miracles.
